question: Should Feishu always redact matching contact identifiers before every outbound send, or preserve exact content and redact only after audit rejection code 230028?
rationale: Both approaches can restore delivery, but they make different user-visible promises about message fidelity, privacy, retries, and silent content modification; tests cannot choose that policy.

options.title: Retry after audit rejection
options.body: Preserve exact content by default, detect code 230028, and retry once with visibly marked redaction across supported send and streaming paths.

options.title: Accept unconditional redaction
options.body: Approve the current pre-send policy and document that matching contact identifiers are always replaced in Feishu.

options.title: Keep exact-content behavior
options.body: Surface the Feishu audit failure clearly rather than automatically modifying generated answers.

recommendation.title: Retry after audit rejection
recommendation.body: Preserve exact content by default, detect code 230028, and retry once with visibly marked redaction across supported send and streaming paths.
